script: In 1962, the US Joint Chiefs of Staff presented a secret plan to the Secretary of Defense called Operation Northwoods. The plan proposed staging fake terror attacks on American soil, including bombings and hijackings, and blaming Cuba for all of it. It even proposed sinking boats full of Cuban refugees to provoke public outrage. The goal was to manufacture a reason for the United States to invade Cuba, using events the military would fake itself. President Kennedy was briefed on the plan and rejected it outright in a meeting weeks later. The document stayed classified for thirty five years, only released in 1997 by a government records review board. Nobody outside a small circle knew any of this had been proposed until decades after the meeting happened. Operation Northwoods stayed secret for thirty five years, until a records board finally let the truth out.

title: The US Military Drafted a Secret Plan to Attack Its Own Citizens
description:
In 1962, the Joint Chiefs of Staff proposed staging fake attacks on American soil and blaming Cuba, to justify an invasion. Kennedy rejected it, and it stayed classified for 35 years.
